crossRefs.note: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous. An arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol, and he…
crossRefs.keyword: pervert. Heb. alter. any of the afflicted. Heb. all thesons of affliction

translations.web: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
translations.bsb: lest they drink and forget what is decreed, depriving all the oppressed of justice.
translations.kjv: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
translations.asv: Lest they drink, and forget the law, And pervert the justice due to any that is afflicted.
